title: Version and logo polish: mark only on a terminal, stale marker clears after a restart
lead: `ork --version` prints the logo mark only when stdout is a terminal; on a pipe or a file its first line is plain `ork VERSION`. The `daemon build differs` marker in the TUI status line clears by itself after `ork daemon restart`, without reopening the TUI.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S54 relay later notes, S103 items (a) and (c); owner decision, 2026-10-31: print the mark on `ork --version` only on a terminal; on a pipe or file line 1 is plain `ork VERSION`. Verified at HEAD:

- (c) `cmd/ork/main.go:102-107` prints the six mark rows first on any stdout and then `ork VERSION`. `brand.ColourWanted` (`internal/brand/mark.go:70-81`) only decides colour: it is true for a character-device stdout without `NO_COLOR`. So `ork --version | head -1` and `ork --version > file` start with glyphs. The tests pinned that order (`cmd/ork/main_test.go:143-148`, `cmd/ork/install_test.go:36-39`). `docs/dashboard.md:207` says `ork --version` also prints the mark. The release dry run in `docs/release.md:19-24` (moved from AGENTS.md in commit aaf79eb) asks the owner to confirm that the binaries print the version with `--version`; a script that reads line 1 of `ork --version` gets glyphs. Doctor's tool probe (`internal/cli/doctor.go:241-262`, `firstLine`) runs `--version` on slicer, adj and the vendor CLIs, not on ork, so doctor is not affected by this change.
- (a) The TUI gets the daemon's build once, before it starts (`cmd/ork/main.go:155-169`, `tui.Config.DaemonBuild`), and `internal/tui/view.go:576` compares that fixed value with the TUI's own build on every draw. After `ork daemon restart` the new daemon has the TUI's build, but the marker stays until the TUI is restarted. The snapshot is the only message that reaches the TUI from the daemon on every refresh; it carries global fields already (`roles_running`, `vendors_out`: `internal/daemon/wire.go:228-243`, `internal/daemon/handlers.go:271-285`). The daemon knows its build (`d.cfg.BuildID`, the same value `daemon.info` returns, `handlers.go:124`). Adding it to the snapshot lets the TUI re-read the build on each refresh. The field is *proposed* (it adds a wire field).

Not in this slice (carried from the old S103; none is requested by the owner and none is a defect that blocks the work): (b) `ork --version` prints the `version` variable while the header shows the short revision, (d) the mono mark drops the bottom pixel of two-colour cells (the owner's pinned glyph), (e) UI-pass ideas not adopted (a `! ` prefix in mono, a darker teal, truecolour downsampling), and the version line in doctor text output that the old Files list named although item (e) says it was not adopted. Text `ork doctor` keeps printing the mark (its output is not a script contract; `docs/dashboard.md:207`).

"Terminal" here means what `ColourWanted` already means: stdout is a character device. The standard library has no isatty; `/dev/null` is a character device too and gets the mark, which is harmless. No dependency is added.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestIsTerminalMeansACharacterDevice` (`internal/brand/mark_test.go`): buffer and pipe false, character device true; NO_COLOR disables colour and absence enables it. First red: undefined IsTerminal.
- `TestVersionLineIsFirstOnAPipe` (`cmd/ork/main_test.go`, replacing TestVersionPrintsAndStartsNoTUI): both version flags produce exactly ork VERSION plus newline with default terminal detection. First red: mark rows precede version.
- `TestVersionPrintsTheMarkOnATerminal` (`cmd/ork/main_test.go`): injected terminal detection preserves mark rows and version. Existing behaviour passes initially after the field seam compiles; mutation must remove the mark and fail.
- `TestInstalledVersionIsPlainOnAPipe` (`cmd/ork/install_test.go`, retaining the documented install check): installed binary produces exactly ork dev plus newline. First red: mark rows precede version.
- `TestSnapshotCarriesTheDaemonBuild` (`internal/daemon/build_test.go`): handler uses cfg.BuildID. First red: absent field, then empty value.
- `TestClientSnapshotCarriesTheDaemonBuild` (`internal/daemon/client_test.go`): client maps snapshot daemon_build into source.Snapshot. First red expected: absent field, then empty value; socket checks may be sandbox-limited.
- `TestStaleMarkerClearsAfterTheDaemonRestarts` (`internal/tui/brand_test.go`, next to TestStaleDaemonWarningInStatusLine): independent startup, restarted, changed-again and empty-snapshot cases assert real status output after Model.apply (`internal/tui/model.go:1132`). First red: restarted marker remains.
- Existing TestStaleDaemonWarningInStatusLine, TestBehindNoticeOnlyWhenIdle and TestBehindNoticeGolden retain config fallback and notice ordering.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Tests first; see each fail for the stated reason.

1. `internal/brand/mark.go`: add `IsTerminal(w io.Writer) bool` (an `*os.File` whose `Stat` mode has `os.ModeCharDevice`) and make `ColourWanted` return `getenv("NO_COLOR") == "" && IsTerminal(w)`.
2. `cmd/ork/main.go`: add `terminal func(io.Writer) bool` to `program`; in `run`, `--version` prints the mark rows only when `terminal(stdout)` is true (nil means `brand.IsTerminal`), then always `ork <version>`. The mark keeps its colour rule (`brand.ColourWanted`). Update `refused(t)` and `inTest(...)` helpers only if the new field needs them (a nil field must work).
3. Daemon and source: add `DaemonBuild string` to `source.Snapshot` and `SnapshotResult` (`json:"daemon_build,omitempty"`), set it in the snapshot handler, map it in the client. Leave `status`, `daemon.info` and the `Unavailable` snapshot alone.
4. TUI: add `daemonBuild string` to `Model`. In `apply`, when `msg.snap.DaemonBuild != ""` set it. In `statusLine`, use `m.daemonBuild` when set and `m.cfg.DaemonBuild` otherwise, for the `StaleBuild` test only. Keep the rest of that branch (the empty-build seam used by tests, the notice order) unchanged.
5. Docs as listed; mark the new wire field and the version-line rule *proposed*. `docs/guide.md:44` and `:422` say the mark is printed only on a terminal, and line 1 is `ork VERSION` otherwise.
6. `CHANGELOG.md`: one entry under `## Unreleased`, added last.
7. Do not touch `internal/cli/doctor.go`, the mark glyph, `headerVersion`, or the golden files except as the check above allows. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

Owner decisions (2026-11-09): How should S103's Check lines that only the orchestrator can run be handled? -> runnable: replace the `/Users/jon/...` roots with `slicer check --root .` and `adj lint --root .`. Replace the piped `go run` line with `go run ./cmd/ork --version > .scratch/v.txt; head -1 .scratch/v.txt`, expecting `ork dev` (or the linker-set version). The implementer's sandbox can run these..
